u457083e40b: 7.3.1. How to check which chip versions the current chip firmware (FW/UFW file) supports
ue28b28217b: When you deploy a file to a 1-to-2 programmer or a 1-to-8 programmer, the tool reports an error similar to the following:
uce401fd3e1: The firmware file contains a KEY, and the programmer also contains a KEY (the programmer's KEY is fixed at the factory and bound to the distributor; users cannot change it). If the two do not match, an error is reported.
u6b8593aa53: The main causes of this error are:
u2507bc7259: The ⟦1⟧-key⟦/1⟧ parameter was not specified when the firmware file was generated, so the generated firmware file has no KEY. Solution: in the download directory, modify the script that generates the firmware file to specify the parameter ⟦2⟧-key keyfile.key⟦/2⟧, where ⟦3⟧keyfile.key⟦/3⟧ is the KEY file obtained from Jieli. As shown below:
u5d02606753: To avoid problems caused by mistyped file names, the key file name should not contain spaces, Chinese characters, etc.; use only English letters and digits.
u8e55069f70: The wrong KEY file was specified when the firmware file was generated. For details, consult your distributor or Jieli.
u499840c1ed: The current programmer may not support programming the corresponding chip. For details, consult your distributor or Jieli.
u24848f8fd3: The programmer must be authorized to program the programming files of a specific chip model. ⟦1/⟧
u1234052e1a: If it is not authorized, the tool reports an error similar to the following when you deploy the programming file to a 1-to-2 or 1-to-8 programmer:
u7b23656b37: If this error occurs, contact Jieli Technology at ⟦1⟧weiyushu@zh-jieli.com⟦/1⟧ to apply for authorization. When you apply, be sure to send a screenshot of the error message.⟦2/⟧
u6acc92897d: After authorization is granted, update the programmer firmware by remote upgrade. Once the remote upgrade succeeds, you can deploy programming files for the corresponding chip model normally.
ub30a2b17f3: Because of chip iterations, the same chip model may exist in several versions (for example, version A, version B, etc.).
u96190e2efd: To adapt to different chip versions, the SDK code sometimes needs some changes. Some older SDK code may have problems if it runs unmodified on a newer chip version.
uc8b3fbaf3b: To prevent the wrong code from being programmed into a mismatched chip version by mistake, the programmer checks the information in the FW file during programming to confirm that the chip matches the FW.
uf35c0ab1a8: If they do not match, a version mismatch error occurs.
uc4d66239a6: If the programmer reports this error, promptly contact whoever provided the SDK.
uab262b986b: How to check which chip versions the current chip firmware (FW/UFW file) supports
u726bfe9960: When you deploy chip firmware, you can check which chip versions the deployed chip firmware (FW/UFW file) supports.
u93d6d884bf: For deployment on the 1-to-8 programmer, see "⟦1⟧Update the target chip firmware to the programmer⟦/1⟧"
u05b0573d20: For deployment on the 1-to-2 programmer, see "⟦1⟧Deploy the target chip firmware to the programmer⟦/1⟧"
u2758d34826: After deployment is complete, the information box at the bottom of the program window shows the supported chip model information, as shown in ⟦1⟧Chip model information⟦/1⟧
ub1d2c8aa5f: If "KEY error or mismatch" (KEY错误或者不匹配) appears during programming with the 1-to-8 programmer, try the following:
uf62e443759: Use the programmer's blank check to confirm whether the chip is blank
u7f28c01a91: If programming fails on a blank chip, check whether the chip's VBAT voltage matches the required programming voltage (⟦1⟧Programming Voltages for Different Chips⟦/1⟧)
u382caf733b: If the error occurs on a non-blank chip, check whether the added key file is correct

uc0d79d3381: This tool generates Token files (⟦1⟧.hex⟦/1⟧) from the CSV files exported by Jieli MFiTools.exe, for use in programming and production testing.

ud0d5a273fc: Log file: after the export, a log file with the ⟦1⟧.export.log⟦/1⟧ extension is generated automatically. It records the following information:

u4c562766f6: Click the ⟦1⟧Export⟦/1⟧ (导出) button. The tool generates the following files in the same directory:
ube52e739b1: Check the log file to confirm that the export time, starting SN, number of Tokens, etc. are correct.
u3de4825b23: Each line of data in the ⟦1⟧.hex⟦/1⟧ file has the following format (big-endian byte order):
u2d541da9d7: CRC16 of all subsequent data starting from byte 6
u83c56c3ec0: Total number of bytes in the line (including the fixed identifier and the checksum)
uaffc681541: Number of data segments that follow
u04e40b91c9: Offset of the first data segment (counted from byte 0)
ue9b26872d7: Length of the first data segment
ub497482176: ID of the first data segment
u35f409b69e: Offset of the second data segment
u3fb496d355: Length of the second data segment
u992cdf8916: ID of the second data segment
u773fc77d77: And so on; each data segment takes 6 bytes (offset + length + ID)
uc2ed3b2f8e: This tool writes the Token files generated by the FindMy Token Export Tool into FindMy devices and runs a series of production line tests.
ub75cbc1494: Supports a frequency offset calibration test with configurable minimum/maximum allowed values.
u46e3569682: Supports a signal strength test with a configurable allowed signal strength range.
uf236afeeb9: Supports product data verification, which compares the data reported by the device with the expected values.
u2da81707b5: Supports manufacturer name verification, which ensures that the manufacturer name returned by the device is as expected.
u9f6d2b98e0: Supports model verification, which checks that the product model returned by the device is correct.
u4cea0d7625: Supports SN / UUID / Token update; the data is written by importing the .hex file generated by the Token Export Tool.
u07c85c293d: Supports firmware upgrade during the production test; the upgrade file can be specified.
u0ee8a5aed9: Supports SN output (currently only over TCP), which sends the SN to a specified server.
u31889bd9af: Supports configuring the action after the production test passes: either only exit production test mode, or exit and then perform a soft power-off.
ue4f11fee51: Supports production test result logs and debug logs; the file name prefix, maximum size and number of rolling files can be configured separately for each log.
u4d4709225f: Edit the findmy_config.ini configuration file according to your production test requirements (see the configuration description below).
u982245f3fd: Double-click the FindMy Production Test Tool to run it; the program loads the configuration automatically.
u1772d93dfe: Plug in the Jieli FindMy Dongle and wait for the tool to recognize it.
u7cae3538fb: Place the FindMy device to be tested on the FindMy Dongle.
ud96ed37131: The tool automatically performs the tests and update operations; wait until the progress is complete.
uee9cd64c7d: Handle the FindMy device according to the test result shown in the window ("Pass" (通过) or "Fail" (失败)).
u930c26a903: The tool is configured through ⟦1⟧findmy_config.ini⟦/1⟧. The settings and their descriptions are as follows:
u1313579326: # SN output (currently only TCP is supported)
ue2589598e1: # Action performed after the production test passes
u92c2140650: # 1 - Exit production test mode and enter soft power-off
u09a62a805a: freq_offset_calib_test – frequency offset calibration test; the minimum/maximum allowed values can be set.
ue2ff313fe2: rssi_test – signal strength test; the allowed range can be set.
u78e65d5b02: product_data_test – product data verification; checks whether the data reported by the device matches expected_data.
u4222ca6aa6: sn_uuid_token_update – SN/UUID/Token update; specifies the .hex file generated by the Token Export Tool.
u50be7cce64: upgrade – whether to upgrade the firmware during the production test, and the upgrade file to use.
ud73e1e223f: sn_print – whether to output the SN information over the network (TCP).
u008ce3d2de: post_test_action – action performed after a successful production test: only exit production test mode, or exit and then perform a soft power-off.
u60cd3294a0: test_log – configuration of the production test result log (file name prefix, size limit, number of rolling files).
ub57872490e: debug_log – configuration of the debug log.
